name: Promptify Chrome Extension ⚙️
description_md:
## What You Get

- 
Ready-to-run Chrome extension for instant prompt injection into Windsurf, Replit, Bolt.new, Lovable, and more.

- 
Kick-Start Prompt that auto-scaffolds your entire vibe-coding workflow instantly—no setup, no hassle.

- Seamless in-browser AI prompting—no tab-switching or copy-pasting required.

- Flexibly switch between powerful GPT-4o, 4o-mini, or other leading models from OpenAI and Anthropic in seconds.

- Securely encrypted local API keys—your data stays private, always.

- Outputs Markdown or plain text for perfect, hassle-free integration into your projects.
